criteria.requirement: No nationality rule is stated for the courses; the YALI Network describes its members as young leaders of sub-Saharan Africa, without a country list.
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.missing: A country list or a statement of who may join the YALI Network or take the courses; the pages name no country.
criteria.quote: the YALI Network consists of over 600,000 current and future young leaders of sub-Saharan Africa

criteria.requirement: Courses are offered in English, French and Portuguese.
criteria.applicant: French and English are among the recorded languages.
criteria.quote: YALI Network Online Courses are currently offered in English, French, and Portuguese

funding.conditions: The courses and videos are free; the YALI Network bears the cost.
Completion certificate (YALI Network Certificate) at no charge stated.
funding.quote: an opportunity to earn a YALI Network Certificate

out_of_pocket: None stated; internet access is the learner's own cost.
